about.text: A Swedish fermented milk with a cohesive, stretchy ('long') texture and mild sourness. It is cultured slowly at low temperature with Lactococcus lactis subsp. cremoris strains that make exopolysaccharides. It was traditional in northern and central Sweden and western Finland, where a dried cloth soaked in old fil carried the culture.
